sql: SELECT 'unit' AS k, name || ' | ativo=' || is_active || ' | fisica=' || coalesce(is_physical::text, 'null') AS v FROM company_units WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' UNION ALL SELECT 'instr', (SELECT string_agg(trim(x), ' /// ') FROM regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(extra_instructions, ''), E'\n') AS x WHERE x ILIKE '%unidade%' OR x ILIKE '%trujillo%' OR x ILIKE '%endere%' OR x ILIKE '%campolim%') FROM ai_agent_settings WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
